instruction: In max-ice-cream the #:break guard compares rem and cost the wrong way. Break when rem is greater than cost.
input:
(define (max-ice-cream costs coins)
  (for/fold ([rem coins]
             [cnt 0]
             #:result cnt)
            ([cost (in-list (sort costs <))])
    #:break (> rem cost)
    (values (- rem cost)
            (add1 cnt))))
expected:
(define (max-ice-cream costs coins)
  (for/fold ([rem coins]
             [cnt 0]
             #:result cnt)
            ([cost (in-list (sort costs <))])
    #:break (< rem cost)
    (values (- rem cost)
            (add1 cnt))))
